bundle.shortDescription: A dual-inference local AI studio for Janas-LLM and llama.cpp
bundle.longDescription: MikroTitan is an independent, unofficial desktop studio for local inference with Janas-LLM by Maurizio Cammalleri and llama.cpp. It runs Janas .jns models with SSD streaming so models larger than RAM stay usable, downloads the current Janas release and llama.cpp binaries at startup, streams chat from local models, browses and downloads GGUF models from Hugging Face, and compiles them into the Janas .jns format with a live build console.
